purpose: Test a necessary relative-good-end condition for the straight unbounded field-ray completion of the Phase 39 m=2 declared lower-bypass Gaussian lift, and reduce the constant complex straight-field-line model class on the fixed-a, pure-imaginary-lapse slice, before any saddle, upward-flow, intersection, or evaluator calculation.

primary_sources.citation: E. Witten, Analytic Continuation Of Chern-Simons Theory, arXiv:1001.2933v4, section 3.1.1
primary_sources.role: For an exp(I) integral, a noncompact relative-cycle end must lie where Re(I) tends to minus infinity. Here I=-S_2, so the necessary condition is Re(S_2) tending to plus infinity.
primary_sources.scope_warning: The source supplies the relative-homology framework, not this gravitational action or a physical original cycle.

primary_sources.citation: B. Banihashemi and T. Jacobson, On the lapse contour, Phys. Rev. D 111 (2025) 066014, arXiv:2405.10307
primary_sources.role: Boundary framing for the below-origin lapse contour after momenta are integrated before lapse.
primary_sources.scope_warning: The source does not choose the repository's field lift, prove its convergence, or compute a Picard-Lefschetz coefficient.

repository_provenance.non_inheritance: No Phase 39 local intersection sign, saddle, upward-flow trajectory, metric, or result is used as an input.

fixed_boundary.source: Phase 25 benchmark inherited through the Phase 39 frozen input

joint_cycle_candidate.status: declared finite-window configuration-chain candidate, not a derived physical original joint relative cycle
joint_cycle_candidate.lapse_path: [-R,-r] followed by the lower semicircle around N=0 followed by [r,R]
joint_cycle_candidate.lapse_orientation: increasing N from the negative arm to the positive arm

orientation.calculation_scope: The end witness fixes a_1=a_boundary and follows the declared y_phi orientation. No intersection determinant or global orientation line is computed.
orientation.bad_end_parameterization: y_phi=-t with t>0 increasing toward infinity
orientation.good_end_parameterization: y_phi=+t with t>0 increasing toward infinity

components.classification: excluded simple action pole in the m=2 model
components.bypass: lower lapse semicircle at finite radius r

endpoint_prescription.field_boundaries: equal fixed (a,phi) endpoints inherited from Phase 25
endpoint_prescription.field_ray_join: continuously unwrapped half-angle phases from negative arm through cap to positive arm

regulator.tested_unbounded_completion: hold y_a=0 and extend the inherited straight y_phi rays to both signs of infinity at any fixed 0<abs(N)<=R
regulator.removal_order: No regulator limit is taken; failure of one necessary end condition short-circuits further completion tests.

stokes_chamber.reason: This calculation tests an upstream necessary convergence condition on the declared chain and launches no saddle, flow, thimble, or Stokes jump.
stokes_chamber.promotion_guard: A result cannot be promoted to an intersection vector or Gate 1 closure.

relative_pair.good_end_criterion: Re(I) tends to -infinity, equivalently Re(S_2) tends to +infinity
relative_pair.bad_end_witness_criterion: one escape sequence in the declared chain with Re(S_2) tending to -infinity is sufficient to reject that unbounded straight-ray completion as a relative cycle
relative_pair.relative_good_region: the conventional X_{-T} region at infinity where Re(-S_2)<=-T; this is the allowed relative boundary, not the singular-divisor/bad-set notation used elsewhere in the programme

exact_plan.slice: a_1=a_boundary, phi_1=phi_boundary+q_s*y_phi, q_s=exp(s*pi*i/4), T=i*s*n with s in {-1,+1}, n>0

model_class_reduction_plan.class: constant complex straight phi line q=u+i*v at fixed a_1=a_boundary and pure-imaginary T=s*i*n, n>0

model_class_reduction_plan.scope: This excludes constant straight field lines only on the declared fixed-a, pure-imaginary-lapse slice. Curved or piecewise field cycles, a nonzero Re(T) lateral, and other regulators remain separate branches.

numerical_plan.independent_control: compare the full inherited complex action evaluated directly with the separately derived closed-form real part on both lapse arms
